General Dynamics Mission Systems engineers high-technology solutions, products, and services for defense and scientific missions. The company is seeking a Junior Embedded RUST Software Engineer to develop mission-critical, NSA-certified cybersecurity devices using custom hardware as part of a cross-functional Cyber group. The role focuses on embedded Rust software development, testing, debugging, maintenance, and collaboration across systems, hardware, cybersecurity, and test teams.

Responsibilities
Make the world’s most advanced Cybersecurity and Encryption products even smarter
As a Junior Embedded RUST Software Engineer, working with custom Hardware built in-house, for our Cyber group, you’ll be a member of a cross functional team responsible for developing mission critical NSA-certified Cybersecurity devices in a rapidly growing product line. You’ll be working at the cutting edge of Cybersecurity and high-speed data

Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information
U.S. citizenship is required
Preferred
Agile experience preferred
Real-Time multi-threaded Embedded software, preferably on Linux OS
Long development lifecycle and product lifespans, requiring maintenance and regular technology refresh
Demonstrated experience developing production-quality software in Rust, including designing, coding, testing, debugging, and maintaining reliable applications or services
Proficiency with Rust's ownership, borrowing, lifetimes, error handling, and concurrency models to build safe, performant, and maintainable software
Experience designing and implementing systems-level, embedded, backend, networking, or performance-sensitive software using Rust
Ability to develop and maintain automated unit, integration, and/or hardware-in-the-loop test coverage for Rust-based software
Familiarity with the Rust toolchain and ecosystem, such as Cargo, crates, dependency management, formatting, linting, and CI/CD integration
Experience troubleshooting complex software defects, performing code reviews, and contributing to sound software engineering practices in a collaborative development environment
Ability to work across disciplines—including systems, hardware, cybersecurity, test, and program teams—to translate technical requirements into robust software solutions
Experience with related languages (for example, C/C++, Python) and modern software development practices is a plus, particularly for integrating Rust into established codebases

Proficiency with software tools supporting Integrated Development Environments (IDE), version control, defect tracking, and scripting
Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation
Benefits
An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development.
Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security
Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule)
Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs (including on-site gym), employee resource and social groups, and more
Sign-On Bonus Eligible for New Hires
